description: Generate a trace marker report. A filename may be given. If not specified, the filename will be “traceMarkerReport.txt” by default.

keywords.name: filename
keywords.description: Write the report to this file instead of the default.

notes: Without `filename` the report is written to `traceMarkerReport.txt` in the working directory.
`filename` is accepted but is not listed by the engine's own `massflow marker trace-report ?` enumeration.
File format: see reference topic 'file-formats trace-marker-report'.
